baseline_construction_method.value: The energy baseline was developed by separately fitting a multivariate linear regression (MLR) and a multi-layer perceptron ANN (trained with Levenberg-Marquardt and gradient-descent algorithms in MATLAB) to daily plant data; 8 independent drivers were selected (brainstorming with plant engineers, confirmed by linear correlation R and p-values) and the data split 90% training / 10% testing, with predicted outputs taken as the baseline.
evidence_quote: both MLR and MLP ANN methods are utilized for further analysis, modeling and predicting the consumption of the days ahead as a baseline
we applied 1,713 data to train the network, and then 181 data to validate the models performance
The mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) between the predicted outputs and actual data are measured to validate the models
The R2 coefficients and MAPE results are calculated
